code:
_start:
    ; Set up arguments for main
    ; argc is in rdi, argv on stack
    call main         ; call programmer's main()
    ; After main returns, call exit():
    mov  %eax, %edi   ; exit code = main's return value
    call exit
description: The runtime entry point prepares to call main, then passes its result to exit.

steps.description: _start is the entry point. Its comments identify argument setup before it calls main.
After main returns, the code moves its return value into the exit-code argument and calls exit.

title: Start before main
